Dimitra Pavlou ( Greek : Δήμητρα Παύλου , born 21 April 2004) is a Greek tennis player. Pavlou has a career-high singles ranking of world No. 410, achieved on 27 November 2023. She also has a career-high doubles ranking by the WTA of 362, reached on 5 August 2024. So far, she has won three singles and seven doubles title on the ITF Circuit . Pavlou also has represented Greece in the Fed Cup with a win/loss record of 0–2.
